# QuickJS 2026-06-04

Source: https://bellard.org/quickjs/quickjs-2026-06-04.tar.xz
License: MIT, original LICENSE and source notices retained in the archive and
installed under usr/share/licenses/quickjs. SHA256 is recorded in the sidecar
and independently checked by the build recipe; no upstream signature claim.

Only the core is selected, not qjs/qjsc/quickjs-libc or the OS/file/thread
modules. Generated adaptations and deliberate absent features are documented
in docs/architecture/RING3_JAVASCRIPT_CORE_CONTRACT.md. The original archive
is unchanged. No complete ECMAScript/browser compatibility claim.
